rules: HM Land Registry's current INSPIRE download listing is published 5 July 2026
the current INSPIRE download listing states that files are updated on the first Sunday of every month
the current INSPIRE download listing provides data for Barnet
the current INSPIRE download listing provides data for Enfield
INSPIRE polygons are downloaded by local authority
a GIS application is required to view the downloaded INSPIRE polygons
downloading INSPIRE data is subject to the Open Government Licence
HM Land Registry describes INSPIRE data as free of charge
HM Land Registry describes INSPIRE as a monthly-updated dataset
HM Land Registry's INSPIRE landing page identifies Geography Markup Language as the download format
the INSPIRE landing page reports an average file size of approximately 13.66 MB
HM Land Registry's INSPIRE landing page states that no API is available for this dataset
HM Land Registry positions bulk INSPIRE downloads for business and professional use
INSPIRE files are organised separately by local authority
a polygon crossing a local-authority boundary can occur in more than one local-authority file
downloaded INSPIRE data can be stored and integrated with other geographic information in GIS workflows
Planning Data entity search supports JSON output
Planning Data entity search supports HTML output
Planning Data entity search supports GeoJSON output

an individual Planning Data entity can be returned as HTML

the dataset-list endpoint supports HTML output

a specific Planning Data dataset can be returned as HTML

Planning Data entity results include the entity name field
Planning Data entity results include the dataset field
Planning Data entity results include start-date and geometry or point fields when available

the National LIDAR Programme was designed to provide accurate elevation data at 1 metre spatial resolution for all England
England was divided into 302 survey blocks for the National LIDAR Programme
the National LIDAR Programme survey-block division was established in 2017
phase 1 National LIDAR Programme surveys were primarily captured during winter months
the documented winter flying window is approximately November to April
phase 1 capture occurred between January 2017 and February 2023
the National LIDAR Programme uses phases to distinguish repeated survey capture
a second capture of an area is recorded as a later phase rather than replacing provenance
repeat National LIDAR surveys are commissioned according to ongoing operational need
the Environment Agency does not plan a rolling recapture of every phase-1 block
National LIDAR Programme data publication is described as quarterly and ongoing
National LIDAR Programme data is published through the DEFRA survey data portal
the National LIDAR Programme provides a full downloadable geodatabase representation
the National LIDAR Programme provides GeoJSON downloads
the National LIDAR Programme provides GeoPackage downloads
the National LIDAR Programme provides ESRI Shapefile downloads
the published National LIDAR Programme temporal coverage begins 11 November 2016
the published National LIDAR Programme temporal coverage extends to 5 May 2023
Environment Agency Coverage Metadata - Survey Data has identifier 9f0fa3fc-a860-4729-adc9-47fe53f658d0
Coverage Metadata - Survey Data is licensed under the Open Government Licence
Environment Agency is the publisher of Coverage Metadata - Survey Data
Coverage Metadata - Survey Data exposes a WMS service
Coverage Metadata - Survey Data exposes a WFS service
Coverage Metadata - Survey Data exposes an OGC API Features service

OS Downloads API exposes download links for OpenData products
GET /products lists OpenData products
the OpenData products endpoint supports an expanded parameter

GET /products/{productId}/downloads lists downloadable files for an OpenData product
the OpenData downloads endpoint supports filtering by fileName
the OpenData downloads endpoint supports filtering by format
the OpenData downloads endpoint supports filtering by subformat
the OpenData downloads endpoint supports filtering by area
area=GB represents a Great Britain-wide download where available
TQ is a supported 100 km National Grid area code in the OpenData download area filter
the OpenData downloads endpoint supports a redirect parameter

an unknown or unavailable OpenData resource can return HTTP 404

OS Downloads API can be used to discover the formats available for a product
OS Downloads API does not provide access to previous releases of OpenData products
